title: Subsurface marine heatwaves
query: Using the supplied CMOMS daily temperature, salinity and velocity for 2011-2020, investigate marine heatwaves below the sea surface in the South China Sea. Where and when are subsurface heatwaves most frequent and intense, how often do they occur without a surface heatwave above them, and what physical processes produce them? Justify your detection method and baseline, and support the mechanisms with quantitative evidence.
